blocks.v: DEVI Collections began with a single block-printed bed cover carried home from Bagru, and the slow realisation that almost nothing sold online was made the way that one was.

The print on that cover was not quite even. Each block had been placed by eye, and in a few places the register slipped by a millimetre or two. A factory would have rejected it. We have spent the years since looking for exactly that.
What we sell

Bed linen from Bagru and Sanganer, printed with carved teak blocks by people whose fathers carved them. Kantha from Bolpur, where a single dohar is about nine days of one woman's stitching. Razais filled with hand-teased cotton in Jaipur. Handloom ikat from Pochampally, where the yarn is dyed before it ever reaches the loom. Four things, done properly, rather than forty done once.
How we buy

Directly, in small batches, from the people who make the work. We do not run a factory and we do not hold a warehouse of thousands of units. When something sells out it stays out until the next batch, which is usually a few weeks and occasionally a season.

This has a consequence we would rather state than have you discover: pieces vary. Two of the same bed cover will not be identical, an indigo dyed one week sits a shade apart from the next week's vat, and every kantha patchwork quilt is cut from whatever saris came in. If you need two things to match exactly, tell us before you order and we will check.
What we are still building

This website takes orders but does not yet take payment. There is no server behind it, so an order you place here is saved in your own browser and reaches us when you send it on WhatsApp or call. That is a real limitation and not a soft launch — we would rather be a shop that is honest about its counter than one that pretends to a card machine it has not installed.
We answer during working hours and usually within a few hours. If you are asking about a piece you have already ordered, send the order code and it will be quicker.
Before you write

v: For a question about sizes, fabric or care, the product page usually has it under Specifications.
For an order you have placed, quote the DC- code from your confirmation.
For a wholesale or bulk enquiry, tell us the quantity and the date you need it by.

blocks.v: Where we are
contact.hours
What this website stores, and where

Almost everything stays on your own device. Your basket, your wishlist, the details you type at checkout and any order you create are saved in your browser's local storage. They are not sent anywhere, they do not reach us, and they do not follow you to another device or another browser.
Clearing your browser data erases all of it, and there is no copy for us to restore. The My Account page has a Clear everything button that does the same thing deliberately.
What reaches us

Only what you send. When you tap Send on WhatsApp, call, or email us an order, the contents of that message reach us through that channel and are then governed by that channel's own policies as well as this one. We keep what you send for as long as we need it to fulfil and account for the order.
What we do not do

v: No analytics, no tracking pixels, no advertising cookies. There is no third-party script on this site other than the webfont.
We do not sell, rent or share your details with anyone outside the people who fulfil your order.
We do not store card details. No card number ever reaches this website.

blocks.v: Fonts
The typefaces load from Google Fonts, which means Google receives your IP address as part of serving them. That is the only third-party request this site makes.
Your rights
Write to us to ask what we hold about you, to correct it, or to have it deleted. Since most of it is on your own device, deleting it is usually something you can do yourself and immediately.
The window

Seven days from delivery to tell us something is wrong, and we will arrange the return. Write to us before sending anything back so we can book the pickup — an unannounced parcel is hard to match to an order.
What we take back

v: Anything damaged in transit. Photograph it before unpacking further if you can.
Anything that is not what the product page described.
Anything unused, unwashed and with its tags on, if you simply did not like it.

blocks.v: What we cannot take back

v: Anything made or altered to order.
Anything washed or worn, unless the fault is ours.

Variation in a hand-made piece. Block print registers unevenly, kantha stitching is irregular, and handloom ikat feathers differently at every edge. That is what you are buying, and the product pages say so.

blocks.v: Refunds
To the original payment method once the piece is back with us and checked, usually within five working days. Shipping charges are refunded only when the return is our fault.
Exchanges
For a different size, yes, subject to stock. Tell us the size you want when you write and we will hold it while the return travels.
Charges
The free-shipping threshold is measured on the value of the goods before any discount code is applied. A coupon will never take away free shipping a basket had already earned.
Oversized items

Anything oversized travels as freight rather than as a parcel. Its handling charge applies once per oversized item in the basket, not per unit of quantity, and it is shown separately at checkout so you can see exactly what it is for.
Dispatch
Once an order is confirmed we dispatch within the window below. Confirmation is a person at DEVI replying to you — it is not automatic, because nothing on this site is automatic yet.
shipping.shipsIn
Where we deliver
Anywhere in India. We do not ship internationally at present. Remote PIN codes occasionally add two or three days, and we will tell you when we confirm rather than after you have waited.
Tracking
There is no tracking page on this site, because there is no server to hold tracking data. We send the courier's tracking number on WhatsApp when the parcel leaves.
What an order on this site is

Placing an order here creates a record in your browser and nothing more. It is a request, not a contract. A contract exists only once we have received your order through WhatsApp, telephone or email and replied to confirm it, at which point we will also confirm the price and availability.
We may decline an order, most often because something has sold out between your placing it and our seeing it. If that happens we will tell you and refund anything already paid.
Prices
In Indian Rupees and inclusive of GST where it applies. We may change prices at any time, but never on an order we have already confirmed.
Payment

This website does not take payment. A UPI QR code is shown so you can pay from your own banking app directly to us, and nothing on this page can confirm whether that payment succeeded — our bank record is the only source of truth. Where a card gateway is offered in future, a payment is confirmed by our team and not by this page.
Hand-made goods

Colour, print registration, stitching and dimensions vary between pieces of the same product. Photographs and the generated artwork on this site are representative, not exact. This variation is not a defect and is not grounds for return.
Intellectual property

The text, artwork and design of this site belong to DEVI Collections. The craft traditions it draws on belong to the communities that have practised them for generations, and we claim nothing over those.
Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes fall to the courts with jurisdiction over our registered address.
